description: Always-on AI agents from xAI and Cursor that work autonomously across your tools and apps.
notes: This laelluo package is named grok-bot (same as extras). Prefer: scoop install laelluo/grok-bot. Or uninstall the extras package first, then install.
Quit Grok Bot completely before scoop install/update/uninstall. Scoop will not kill the process.
Update with: scoop update grok-bot. Turn OFF in-app auto-update (Settings). In-app NSIS updates write under LocalAppData\Programs\Grok Bot.

On install, existing %APPDATA%\Grok Bot is safely migrated into persist\roaming (copy + SHA256 verify + rename source to *.scoop-grok-bot-backup). Confirm the app works, then you may delete the backup.
Existing %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Grok Bot that looks like an NSIS/Electron tree is deleted (not copied); a symlink to empty persist\programs intercepts further NSIS writes.
If persist\roaming already has different data while AppData is still an ordinary directory, install refuses to merge.
Ordinary uninstall removes owned symlinks only; Scoop persist and *.scoop-grok-bot-backup directories are kept.
